clientId.title: DB RIS Stations Client ID
clientId.description: Deutsche Bahn RIS API client ID.

steps: Register/log in to the DB API Marketplace via 'DB Kundenkonto'.
Create an application with 'Neue Anwendung erstellen'.
In the Katalog, open 'RIS::Stations' and subscribe ('Abonnieren') a plan (start with the free Testzugang).
Open the application's details and copy its Client ID into this field.
x-openmapx-setup.cost: Free test access (2 months, ~10,000 req/month); paid plans run roughly EUR 4,200-84,000/year.
x-openmapx-setup.notes: RIS::Stations access is granted only after a positive authorization check by Deutsche Bahn AG. One DB application can serve all three DB RIS integrations — they share the same Client ID / API key pair.

steps: Register/log in to the DB API Marketplace and create an application ('Neue Anwendung erstellen').
Copy the Client Secret (API key) shown once during application creation.
Subscribe ('Abonnieren') the 'RIS::Stations' product (Testzugang or a paid plan) to that application.
Paste the Client Secret here (sent as the DB-Api-Key header).
x-openmapx-setup.cost: Free test access (2 months, ~10,000 req/month); paid plans run roughly EUR 4,200-84,000/year.
x-openmapx-setup.notes: Access requires Deutsche Bahn AG approval. The Client Secret is shown only once at creation; regenerate it if lost.
